login.title: Đăng nhập tài khoản | DICHVUDEV.VN
login.submit_cls: group/button inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-clip-padding text-sm whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none select-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-de
login.input_cls: h-9 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-2.5 py-1 text-base transition-colors outline-none file:inline-flex file:h-6 file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium file:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-cmstdev focus-vi
rules: :root { --background: #fff; --foreground: #0a0a0a; --card: #fff; --card-foreground: #0a0a0a; --popover: #fff; --popover-foreground: #0a0a0a; --primary: #171717; --primary-foreground: #fafafa; --secondary: #f5f5f5; --secondary-foreground: #171717; --muted: #f5f5f5; --muted-foreground: #737373; --accent: #f5f5f5; --accent-foreground: #171717; --destructive: #e40014; --border: #e5e5e5; --input: #e5e5e5; --ring: #a1a1a1; --cmstdev: #ff566c; --chart-1: #90c5ff; --chart-2: #3080ff; --chart-3: #155dfc; --chart-4: #1447e6; --chart-5: #193cb8; --radius: .625rem; --sidebar: #fafafa; --sidebar-foreground: #0a0a0a; --sidebar-primary: #171717; --sidebar-primary-foreground: #fafafa; --sidebar-accent: #f5f

.dark { --background: #0a0a0a; --foreground: #fafafa; --card: #171717; --card-foreground: #fafafa; --popover: #171717; --popover-foreground: #fafafa; --primary: #e5e5e5; --primary-foreground: #171717; --secondary: #262626; --secondary-foreground: #fafafa; --muted: #262626; --muted-foreground: #a1a1a1; --accent: #262626; --accent-foreground: #fafafa; --destructive: #ff6568; --border: #ffffff1a; --input: #ffffff26; --ring: #737373; --cmstdev: #ff566c; --chart-1: #90c5ff; --chart-2: #3080ff; --chart-3: #155dfc; --chart-4: #1447e6; --chart-5: #193cb8; --sidebar: #171717; --sidebar-foreground: #fafafa; --sidebar-primary: #1447e6; --sidebar-primary-foreground: #fafafa; --sidebar-accent: #262626; -
.overflow-x-auto, .overflow-x-scroll { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: oklch(from var(--cmstdev) l c h / 30%) transparent; }
.overflow-x-auto::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: oklch(from var(--cmstdev) l c h / 30%); }
.overflow-x-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: oklch(from var(--cmstdev) l c h / 30%); }
.overflow-x-auto::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: oklch(from var(--cmstdev) l c h / 50%); }
.overflow-x-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: oklch(from var(--cmstdev) l c h / 50%); }
.brand-spin .ant-spin-dot-item { background-color: var(--cmstdev); }

.qr-scan-line { background: var(--cmstdev); height: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 8px 1px var(--cmstdev), 0 0 18px 4px var(--cmstdev); animation: 2.4s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running qr-scan; position: absolute; left: -4%; right: -4%; }
.qr-scan-band { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--cmstdev)); height: 38px; margin-top: -38px; position: absolute; left: 0px; right: 0px; }

.antd-spin-dot i { background-color: var(--cmstdev); transform-origin: 50% center; opacity: 0.3; border-radius: 100%; width: 0.45em; height: 0.45em; animation: 1s linear 0s infinite alternate none running antd-spin-fade; display: block; position: absolute; transform: scale(0.75); }

:root { --bprogress-color: var(--cmstdev); --bprogress-height: 4px; --bprogress-spinner-size: 18px; --bprogress-spinner-animation-duration: 400ms; --bprogress-spinner-border-size: 2px; --bprogress-box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cmstdev), 0 0 5px var(--cmstdev); --bprogress-z-index: 99999; --bprogress-spinner-top: 15px; --bprogress-spinner-bottom: auto; --bprogress-spinner-right: 15px; --bprogress-spinner-left: auto; }
